comment: Datasets the quality benchmark downloads at run time. Nothing here is committed to the repository: each entry names the publisher's own URL, the SHA-256 of every file, and the reference products. See DATASETS.md for why each was chosen and what was rejected.

aerial-nadir.title: Bandamaji, Grande Comore (Comoros) drone survey, 2023-06-26

licence.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International
licence.redistribution: allowed with attribution; this benchmark downloads only

aerial-nadir.notes: The publisher states OpenDroneMap reconstructed 102 of 102 images at a 2.4 cm GSD over 0.048 km^2.

terrestrial-laser.title: ETH3D high-res multi-view training scene 'terrains'
terrestrial-laser.publisher: ETH Zurich, Computer Vision and Geometry Group (Schops et al., CVPR 2017)
terrestrial-laser.flight: oblique handheld DSLR (ground-truth geometry reference, not a drone flight)

licence.name: Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0 International
licence.redistribution: not allowed; the benchmark downloads inside the CI job only and never commits or publishes the data

terrestrial-laser.notes: The scan_eval archive holds the laser scans already aligned into the image frame, so it is used instead of the 1.9 GB full ground-truth bundle. ETH3D's own evaluator scores accuracy and completeness at 2/5/10 cm; this benchmark reports the same tolerances.
